operations.description:
Gets the latest state of a long-running operation.  Clients can use this
method to poll the operation result at intervals as recommended by the API
service.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] cloudasset projects operations [PATH] v 1beta 1 [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key name oauth pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] operation

operations.description:
Batch gets the update history of assets that overlap a time window.
For RESOURCE content, this API outputs history with asset in both
non-delete or deleted status.
For IAM_POLICY content, this API outputs history when the asset and its
attached IAM POLICY both exist. This can create gaps in the output history.
If a specified asset does not exist, this API returns an INVALID_ARGUMENT
error.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] cloudasset projects batch assets history [PATH] v 1beta 1 parent batch assets history [PARAMS] access alt asset callback content end fields key names oauth parent pretty print protocol quota read start time token type upload user window xgafv [SCHEMA] asset assets batch history response temporal time window

operations.description:
Exports assets with time and resource types to a given Cloud Storage
location. The output format is newline-delimited JSON.
This API implements the google.longrunning.Operation API allowing you
to keep track of the export.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] cloudasset projects export assets [PATH] v 1beta 1 parent export assets [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key oauth parent pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] assets config destination export gcs operation output request
